short_description:

Stand between the innocent and the damned.

You and your team board a mining ship in distress, to identify and capture the alien organism, that
has entered the ship. Work together to identify the alien's unique traits, to produce an effective tranquilizer 
and capture the alien.

And patience is key.

short_description: Gnome or Dwarf ? Either way you're a GWARF ! Collaborate and betray your friends in this social deduction game. Mine, collect ores and vote the traitors out. Also watch out for the saboteur who will try to ruin the expedition !

tags: First-Person, Horror, Online Co-Op, Procedural Generation, Psychological Horror, Walking Simulator, Stealth, Sci-fi, Multiplayer, Psychological
short_description: Hellrooms: 4-player co-op horror in liminal spaces. Realistic graphics, procedural levels, terrifying entities. Swim, solve puzzles, survive together. You and your friends must survive the night, uncover the mystery, and complete the ritual to banish the darkness.

short_description: A chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek game where tiny Nanobots complete tasks, sabotage the Hunter and betray each other to escape. Watch out: the Hunter can hijack your camera at any moment. Look at a wall... or point straight at your friends.

short_description: This 1-4 player cooperative horror game centers on breath and sound management. In darkness, every breath, step, and collision can expose you to the Lich King. Team up to gather resources, distract threats, and rescue each other.

name: Hide & Shriek
tags: Horror, Online Co-Op, Multiplayer, Action, Psychological Horror, Adventure, Stealth, Indie, Pixel Graphics, Top-Down
short_description: One seeker. A handful of hiders. A derelict asylum that hears every footstep you take. Sprint and you are heard; crouch and you are slow. Learn the dark, learn the edges of a torch beam, and decide when to leave the space under the bed.

name: L.O.S.T.
tags: Action, 3D, First-Person, Horror, Stealth, Multiplayer, Online Co-Op, Early Access, Singleplayer
short_description: A horror game with up to 5 players. Locate valuables and handle them with care as you extract and record your expidition as you encounter scary things...

name: Get Us Out
tags: Adventure, Multiplayer, Online Co-Op, Funny, Puzzle, Exploration, Comedy, Indie, Stealth, Crime
short_description: GET US OUT is a 1–4 player co-op escape game. Sneak past guards, steal keys, disable security, solve puzzles, and rescue captured teammates. Plan together, improvise when things go wrong, and get everyone out.

name: HOLLOWED Co.
tags: Horror, Survival Horror, Online Co-Op, Multiplayer, PvP, Action, Adventure, PvE, Stealth, First-Person
short_description: A chaotic multiplayer horror game where a paranormal recovery crew hunts cursed relics in haunted locations — while monsters hunt them back and corrupted teammates hide among the crew. Work together, uncover the impostors, and survive long enough to escape.

name: CAT BURGLARS™
tags: Action, Online Co-Op, Stealth, Heist, Co-op, Cute, Adventure, First-Person, Creature Collector, PvE
short_description: In CAT BURGLARS™, cats are spies!! Use high-tech gadgets to pull off daring heists with up to 9 of your friends! Gather enemy intel, crack open vaults, and cause mayhem as you build your crew from a HUGE roster of cute cats.

name: LootPanic
tags: Heist, Social Deduction, Multiplayer, PvP, Stealth, Online Co-Op, Team-Based, Crime, Action, Open World
short_description: Break into a town of 20 targets, crack the safes, and haul the loot to the black market before the cops close in. Play as a thief, play as police — or be the mole working both sides. Up to 12 players. Plan quietly, panic loudly.

name: Echo Mates
tags: Co-op, Online Co-Op, Horror, Survival Horror, Multiplayer, Adventure, Stealth, Action, First-Person, PvE
short_description: To see, you must speak. To speak is to be found. A co-op horror in near-total darkness where every sound sends out a wave that lights the level — and calls whatever lives in it. 1–4 players, real voice, microphone required.

name: Don't Wake the King
tags: Survival Horror, Team-Based, Perma Death, Stealth, Online Co-Op, Procedural Generation, Party Game, Old School, Psychological Horror, Exploration
short_description: A co-op horror for up to four players that hears your real voice. Whisper while you search a procedurally generated forest for cursed bones - speak too loudly and the blind king beneath it wakes. Escape alive, and the next raid is worth double. Wipe, and you lose everything.

name: Sussy NPC
tags: Social Deduction, Multiplayer, Online Co-Op, Team-Based, PvP, Party Game, Stealth, Funny, Comedy, Co-op
short_description: You're a sussy NPC in a crowd of NPCs. Hunters are hunting you. Act normal, blend in, don't flinch. Or be the Hunter, read the room and catch them. In-game voice chat is recommended for the best experience.

name: rogOut
tags: Traditional Roguelike, Roguelike, Perma Death, Survival Horror, Crafting, Procedural Generation, Co-op, Online Co-Op, Dark, Stealth
short_description: rogOut is a cooperative turn-based ASCII extraction survival roguelike. Explore abandoned locations full of mysterious creatures, scavenge scarce high-tech loot, and uncover what happened to the world after the Dark Fold.

name: Wish Impossible
tags: Online Co-Op, Co-op, Physics, Multiplayer, Comedy, Stealth, Funny, First-Person, Adventure, Action
short_description: Wish Impossible is a 1–4 player online co-op physics game where tiny gingerbread cookies sneak into sleeping homes to grant Christmas wishes — without waking anyone up. Move oversized objects, use ridiculous tools, and survive the chaos your friends create.

name: Samt
tags: Stealth, Horror, Adventure, Thriller, Action, Co-op, Sci-fi, Artificial Intelligence, Parkour, Online Co-Op
short_description: Samt is a 2-player online co-op stealth game. Silence keeps you alive. Real voice, footsteps, and movement are heard by hunting AI drones in a dead, neon-lit mega-city. Stay quiet. Survive together, or evaporate trying. This game requires a co-op partner: no solo play.

name: Manikin Mimic
tags: PvP, Action, Online Co-Op, Multiplayer, Co-op, Stealth, Party Game, Casual, Arcade, Exploration
short_description: Pose, blend in, and don’t get caught! Pretend to be one of the Manikins and fool the Finder before they blast you.

name: Sonus
tags: Casual, Multiplayer, Party Game, Horror, Online Co-Op, Stealth, PvP, Co-op, Survival, Exploration
short_description: Seek the Sonus Stone while hiding from the Stone Keepers that lurk in the dark. Use echoes to navigate through the dark world, and use special echoes to give you an advantage with their unique abilities.

name: My Friend is Blind
tags: Online Co-Op, Puzzle, Co-op, Co-op Campaign, Stealth, Funny, Espionage, First-Person, Multiplayer, Casual
short_description: A two-player online co-op puzzle game where one of you sees everything and the other almost nothing. The Guide spots the mines, traps and guards; the Blind has to get through every trial trusting only their partner's voice. Talk, fail, explode, try again.

name: The Sabotage
tags: Multiplayer, Online Co-Op, Mining, Survival, Action, Exploration, Simulation, 3D, First-Person, Stealth
short_description: The Sabotage is a multiplayer coop in which players try to find gold together, while one of them, as a saboteur, tries to prevent this from happening.

name: Nightmare Party
tags: Horror, Action, Survival Horror, FPS, Online Co-Op, Multiplayer, Shooter, PvE, Stealth, First-Person
short_description: Play alone or team up with others and try to survive while a demon and its minions try to kill you. Your goal is simple. Escape. This might sound easy, but dealing with evil entities is a dangerous business!

name: Gamma Nocturne 1
tags: Horror, Survival Horror, Online Co-Op, Singleplayer, Action, Adventure, Artificial Intelligence, First-Person, Stealth, Multiplayer
short_description: Gamma Nocturne 1 is a 1-4 player online co-op horror game. A research mission on a newly discovered earth-like planet has failed. You and your crew must stop the members of the new race from reaching Earth. How could you know that this frozen alien would come to life when thawed?

name: BLOODMIST
tags: Indie, Early Access, Horror, Stealth, Online Co-Op, Singleplayer, Dark
short_description: Bloodmist is a co-op horror game. Explore eerie environments, work together to survive, and complete dangerous objectives before the evil in the mist finds you. The nightmare won’t end until the mist fades.

name: The Nightscarred: Forgotten Gods
tags: Action, First-Person, Immersive Sim, Online Co-Op, Assassins, Stealth, Fantasy, Female Protagonist, Atmospheric, Co-op
short_description: Steel and sorcery collides in a fast-paced immersive sim. Master melee, wield magic, stealth in the shadows, and manipulate the environment—alone or in co-op. From the Altai Mountains to the Great Wall, every choice shapes your path in this tale of power, betrayal, and redemption.

name: Daedalus: You Have Been Chosen
tags: Horror, Multiplayer, Survival Horror, Psychological Horror, Online Co-Op, Action, Stealth, Team-Based, Atmospheric, Procedural Generation
short_description: Go on a scary adventure, whether you decide to face the dangerous path alone or team up with your friends. This intense game guarantees a mysterious experience every time you play. Get ready to solve tricky puzzles, avoid a terrifying monster, and fight your way out of the intricate maze.

name: Viral Fear
tags: Action, Horror, Stealth, Co-op, Online Co-Op, Arcade, 3D, Realistic, Third Person, Atmospheric
short_description: Step into the shoes of a daring live streamer in Viral Fear, a spine-chilling 1 to 4 player co-op adventure. Stealthily maneuver through the woods, destroy ritual skulls, and unravel the secrets of the cult to vanquish the nightmarish entity.

name: Mutants Of Mist
tags: Survival Horror, Exploration, Online Co-Op, Time Management, Stealth, Horror, Multiplayer, Atmospheric, Thriller, Jump Scare
short_description: A 1-4 player survival horror game where you collect evidence while trying to escape a strange mist. With the mist surrounding you, and mutants hunting you, will you survive with the evidence you have, or fall victim to the mist yourself?

name: The Bunker Complex
tags: Horror, Psychological Horror, 1990's, Online Co-Op, Realistic, First-Person, Mystery, Adventure, Singleplayer, Stealth
short_description: 'The Bunker Complex' is a 2 player co-op horror game. Players fight for survival in an old bunker.

name: REV UP
tags: Racing, Driving, Open World, Stealth, Stylized, Exploration, Co-op, Online Co-Op, Arcade, Crime
short_description: A multiplayer arcade racing game with a cops vs. racers system and stealth mechanics, set in an open-world cyberpunk city. As a street racer, escape or hide from cops while taking part in non-linear races. As a cop, hunt down racers by using equipment and teamwork.

name: Loot Goblin Inc.
tags: Loot, Capitalism, First-Person, Online Co-Op, Sci-fi, Stealth, Life Sim, Exploration, Physics, Dark Humor
short_description: Break into homes, steal valuables, and sell them online to make big cash money! Join the corporate goblin world in this very cool Loot Goblin Simulation!

name: Don't Breathe
tags: Action, Puzzle, Mystery Dungeon, 3D, Psychological Horror, Stealth, Co-op, Online Co-Op, Indie, Multiplayer
short_description: “Players in the game as a trapped person, with a variety of monsters game, avoid dangerous organs, explore strange phenomena, collect information to solve the mystery, escape from this place.”

name: Hide 'n Heist
tags: RPG, Stealth, PvP, Online Co-Op, Heist, First-Person, Third Person, Social Deduction, Casual, Detective
short_description: 4 Thieves vs. 1 Guardian! A medieval heist game! Play as a thief, disguise yourself among the crowd, and steal the treasure, or take on the role of the guardian and hunt down the thieves! Everyone has a unique role and strategy. Find the right approach and lead your team to victory!

name: NeuroCorp
tags: Multiplayer, Horror, Cyberpunk, Online Co-Op, First-Person, Co-op, Survival, Exploration, Stealth, Funny
short_description:
A 6 player horror co-op game set in the dystopian future of Grimm City. Do shady work for Neurocorp while evading the terrifying dwellers of this strange city. Or fight them if you dare! All so you can rest and customize your home. 

Please, sign on the dotted line to begin.

name: Protocol: Terminate
tags: Online Co-Op, Survival Horror, Co-op, Tactical, Action, FPS, Robots, Shooter, Stealth, Team-Based
short_description: A co-op survival horror shooter against an AI that learns from your actions. It grows more dangerous, relentlessly hunts you, and turns mistakes into deadly traps. Hide, hack security systems, and work together to survive.

name: Ivory Cage
tags: Horror, Co-op, Online Co-Op, Psychological Horror, Survival Horror, Roguelite, Procedural Generation, Stealth, Replay Value, Dark
short_description: Descent with your team into the depths of an abandoned theme park to repair its broken machinery, and survive what's still down there.

name: Exosystem
tags: Hacking, Immersive Sim, Online Co-Op, Adventure, Indie, Stealth, Sandbox, Difficult
short_description: Hack yourself, hack your friends, hack your enemies and hack EVERYTHING in this twin-stick, action immersive-sim. Use OVERPOWERED hacks that no other game would let you use to overcome intelligent enemies in a plagued simulation.

name: Slashzone
tags: Horror, Time Management, Score Attack, Stealth, Action, PvP, Arcade, Co-op, Survival Horror, Online Co-Op
short_description: Four Volunteers. One relentless Slasher. Each round, the roles change. Work as a team... until betrayal becomes the only way to survive. Manipulate, survive, and outscore every other player. In the end, only one player wins.

name: Obscured Persona
tags: Action, Casual, Strategy, Stealth, Online Co-Op, Multiplayer, Indie, Early Access
short_description: Hide your identity in a mysterious city filled with agents, complete missions, sabotage your rivals, and rise above everyone else to become the sole winner. Remember: here, loyalty is an option, survival is not.

name: S.M.P.C.U. - Special Monster Pest Control Unit
tags: Action, Horror, Online Co-Op, Multiplayer, Roguelite, Survival Horror, Adventure, Tactical, Combat, Stealth
short_description: S.M.P.C.U. is an online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. As a member of the "Special Monster Pest Control Unit" your job is to remove extraterrestrial Monsters that have infested the pantries of fast-food restaurants. Work together to find them, trap them and get out. Don't wake the Monster!

name: RADZIMA
tags: Early Access, Action, Indie, Survival, Horror, Co-op, Stealth, Perma Death, Post-apocalyptic, Online Co-Op
short_description: RADZIMA is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror set in an underground research facility. Find radioactive items, avoid the mutants, and power the elevator reactor to descend deeper - all in service of the Party’s will.

name: Submind
tags: Horror, Online Co-Op, Multiplayer, Action, Comedy, Co-op, Third Person, 3D, Stealth, Survival Horror
short_description: Dive into broken minds, with up to 3 friends, in order to stabilize them. Pick the correct path, solve puzzles, pay attention to your surroundings, all while making sure the patient's mind doesn't go to the point of no return, because if does, you'll be facing their worse traumas and nightmares.

name: GOBLINS! GOBLINS! GOBLINS!
tags: Adventure, Multiplayer, Online Co-Op, Comedy, Fantasy, Stealth, Loot, PvE, Action-Adventure, Platformer
short_description: Grab your friends and unleash your inner goblin in this online co-op game for up to 4 players. Climb rooftops, smash through windows, dodge guards, steal shinies, and ruin everything for everyone. Work together to pull off the perfect heist… or betray your friends for a slightly shinier hat.

name: The Death Archive
tags: Puzzle, Action, Adventure, First-Person, Horror, Psychological Horror, Stealth, Indie, Multiplayer, Online Co-Op
short_description: The Death Archive is a co-op horror game where players explore time-shifted locations, solve puzzles, and coordinate as a team to overcome unique challenges and survive each mission.

name: LiniMall
tags: Horror, Online Co-Op, Dark Comedy, Multiplayer, Co-op, First-Person, 3D, Stealth, Action, Simulation
short_description: Linimall is a fast-paced, horror shop-maintenance game that puts you and up to 5 friends in charge of the night crew at a brand new mall in the 1990's. Clean, restock, and summon eldritch beings to make sure your tasks are done before the mall opens!

name: Skogsvakt
tags: Horror, Online Co-Op, Multiplayer, Co-op, First-Person, 3D, Stealth, Old School, Survival Horror, Stylized
short_description: Take on the role of park rangers within the deep, dark Scandinavian forests. Grab your friends and do your best to survive the night. Ancient folkloric creatures lurk within these hallowed groves, and they do not take kindly to intruders.

name: Agents 404
tags: Action, Funny, Shooter, Parody , Comedy, Party Game, Stealth, Online Co-Op, Multiplayer, Physics
short_description: Agents 404 is a physics-based co-op stealth comedy set in an absurd parody world. As incompetent assassins, infiltrate guarded locations, use goofy disguises, and hide bodies. Work together to eliminate caricatured villains, or watch your clumsy teamwork end in hilarious chaos!
